## Fixed

- **Drime "Too many requests" errors.** When Drime asked r2backup to slow
  down, each request backed off on its own while the rest kept going, and a
  busy backup could fail files with `HTTP 429`. Now one "slow down" pauses
  every Drime request for a moment, waiting it out no longer uses up a file's
  retries, and the backup sends a few fewer files at once until Drime stops
  asking. Backups run at full speed again as soon as Drime allows.

- **Backups failing after a file was deleted in Drime.** If you deleted a
  backed-up file in the Drime web app, every later backup of that folder
  failed with "object not found". Files already gone are now skipped.
